questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

Fortunately, only a few______were hurt in the train accident.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**passengers**'.

__
 
• **The meaning of the given words**__:

 __
 
• **customer**: a person who buys goods from a shop
 
• **passenger**: a traveller on a vehicle
 
• **clients**: a customer or a buyer
 
• **vendors**: a seller or a salesperson
 
 
 
• The given sentence is about the people who were hurt in a train accident and they are called **passengers**.
 
• Hence, **option 2) **is the answer.

• **passenger**: एक वाहन पर एक यात्री
 
• **clients**: एक ग्राहक या एक खरीदार
 
• **vendors**: एक विक्रेता या एक विक्रेता
 
 
 
• दिया गया वाक्य उन लोगों के बारे में है जो एक ट्रेन दुर्घटना में घायल हुए थे और उन्हें **passengers** कहा जाता है।
 
• अत: **option 2)** उत्तर है।

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 Love is the most beautiful feeling*.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

She was __________ right nor wrong.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **neither**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Neither** is **used to introduce a further negative statement.**
 
• **Neither/nor are conjunctions** that connect two parts of a sentence to each other.
 
• They must be used in **parallel structures.**
 
• **Neither/nor is used** when the choice is negative or the person wants to say that more than one thing is not true.

 *** • Example- I neither speak Spanish nor understand it.***

*** It is neither an obsession nor a projection of his mind, although it certainly does compel him.***

So, it is clear that the most appropriate word is 'neither'.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

questions.question:
Fill in the blank with an appropriate option.

Your ear has three main _______: outer, middle and inner.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1' **i.e.** 'Parts'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct option to fill in the blank is **"parts".**
 
• **In the context** of the sentence, we are dividing the ear into its anatomical divisions.
 
• The term **"parts"** is the most suitable choice, as it can refer to the components or sections of a whole, in this case, the ear.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:* 'Your ear has three main** parts**: outer, middle and inner.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2, "subjects", **is incorrect because "subjects" refers to topics, areas of study, or people or things that are being discussed or described. It doesn't fit the context of anatomical divisions.
 
• **Option 3, "plugs",** is incorrect as it doesn't make sense in this context. "Plugs" generally refers to devices for making an electrical connection, blocking a hole, or in a very different sense, a piece of a substance put in a person's ear to block out noise, and none of these meanings fit in this context.
 
• **Option 4, "events",** is incorrect because it generally refers to things that happen, especially important happenings or occurrences, and it doesn't apply to anatomical structures like the parts of the ear.

questions.question:

He had always wanted to work for himself; so, last year he _______ his job at the bank and is now running a tool business.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

• **Example:** He left the party early because he had work the next day.
 
 
 
• **"left"** is the past tense of "leave," which means to depart or resign.
 
• The context tells us that the person quit his job at the bank last year to start his own tool company because he had always wanted to work for himself.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **left**.

• **Example:** After the death of his wife, he felt completely bereft.
 
 
 
• **Halted** (रोक दिया): Brought to an abrupt stop.
 
 
• **Example:** The construction work was halted due to the heavy rain.
 
 
 
• **Cleft** (दरार): Split or severed.
 
 
• **Example:** The rock was cleft in two by the powerful earthquake.
